text: 印度政府周二宣布，立即禁止出口锂离子电池黑粉黑粉是一种电池回收材料，含有锂、钴、镍和锰等金属。印度政府将该产品的出口状态由“自由出口”调整为“禁止出口”。此次政策调整禁止印度电池回收企业出口锂离子电池黑粉，旨在鼓励关键电池材料在印度国内加工，支持印度发展电动汽车供应链的战略目标。根据印度商务和工业部及商务部发布的通知，出口禁令适用于锂离子电池黑粉，以及未经分类且不含铅、镉或汞的相关电池废料。印度是全球增长最快的电动汽车市场之一。印度政府正大力推动本土电池制造和回收产业发展，并设定目标：到2030年，电动汽车占新车销量的30%，占新售两轮和三轮车销量的80
text_en: The Indian government announced on Tuesday an immediate ban on exports of lithium-ion battery black mass, a battery recycling material containing metals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese. The Indian government changed the product's export status from "free export" to "prohibited export." This policy adjustment bans Indian battery recycling companies from exporting lithium-ion battery black mass, aiming to encourage domestic processing of key battery materials in India and support India's strategic goal of developing an electric vehicle supply chain. According to a notification issued by India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry and the Department of Commerce, the export ban applies to lithium-ion battery black mass and related unsorted battery waste that does not contain lead, cadmium or mercury. India is one of the world's fastest-growing electric vehicle markets. The Indian government is vigorously promoting the domestic battery manufacturing and recycling industry and has set targets for electric vehicles to account for 30% of new car sales and 80% of new two- and three-wheeler sales by 2030.
